notes.title: How to mark your calendar
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to yet another update!

Our team is back and deep into production >:) Our focus, as usual, has been on balancing the narrative with the gameplay mechanics, and making sure they both progress well together.

This entails working on our [b]calendar[/b] system. As of today, a year in Neverway is divided into Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter, each with 21 days.

Here’s our very much still work in progress calendar, so you can have a better idea on how that looks like…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/5a21e0c7615b9debf041ddf959787239b9a58dd3.png[/img]

Many things can happen in a day, such as the deadline to pay your mortgage, someone’s birthday, or a game night that happens on the last day of the week.

The idea is that each event is unlocked as you find out about it. For example, you only learn that there’s a breakfast at Mugs after going there that day, or if someone tells you about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/ad857efb41978ba857a4d293f8d691a331b2061b.png[/img]

Pedro also worked on the cutest icons for the characters, which will appear in both the map and calendar UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/ab52f2c2819fe839d5004d5bca164c1c0fc6a82e.png[/img]

Which brings up the question… what makes a good calendar in games for you? You can reply either here on Steam or by [url=https://discord.gg/TbvAdefcz9]joining our Discord[/url]!

We have a lot of fun reading your answers, and Heidy does an awesome job at replying to most of them. We really appreciate your support <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/b32727384d9973b1cc6488fb089e0fe8551105e3.png[/img]
That’s all for today!
🩸 Isa and Coldblood Inc. team

notes.title: Neverway is releasing in 2026!
notes.notes:
Hello!!!! As you may have noticed, we’re very excited today!!!!!!

Neverway was just featured as part of the latest Indie World. Obviously, this means that we’re launching on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]!

[p][previewyoutube=_IkNnvX8Mvo;full][/previewyoutube][/p]
We also got featured in the Japanese Indie World broadcast, look!

[p][previewyoutube=8gJK1lJBppE;full][/previewyoutube][/p]
The Japanese version turned out quite different from the English one, as it's the first time we’re sharing actual spoilers (!!!) for the story, so probably only watch it if you don’t mind the spoilers.

[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/cfdd1ea06796d9ed9914dca99f78f2596289caa3.gif[/img][/p]
Finally, we're ready to announce that Neverway will release in [b]2026[/b], for both PC and Nintendo Switch! Definitely scary and exciting.

[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/f70e38f3d8f8c34e1708afe8aceccc38e939bfb8.png[/img][/p]
*And* we’re part of this year’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025]Tiny Teams[/url] event, which is super cool for a small team like ours!! Although we won’t participate in the stream showcase, we highly recommend checking out all the other cool games there!

[h3]So what's next?[/h3]
Anyway! That was [i]A Lot Of Things[/i]. Honestly, we're just excited to get back and finally focus on creating tons of new content for the game.

After our first in-person event at BitSummit, we were very happy with the reviews and feedback we got from people that played the game. In particular, I loved when people noticed some small details that we added to the game (I really thought no one would notice!), or hearing how the story resonated with them. Over [b]200[/b] people played the whole prologue! And there were zero bugs!!!! Well, except for this one person who managed to talk to an NPC through a wall.

We already have some ideas on how to get the prologue in the best shape possible for an eventual public demo, we'll let you know when the timing is right. Thank you for everyone's support and for trusting us!

[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/c7880b62a1e656f0f2b3a1d186d44b798e1a53aa.gif[/img][/p]
Until next time!
🩸 Isa, and Coldblood Inc. team

notes.title: Breakfast with Aurora
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again!

We thought about explaining a bit more about our characters this time! You'll meet a variety of characters throughout Neverway, who can be either village residents or… something else.

For example, here, you might recognize Aurora!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/4b27f383e43164238624c87797155c839e754ed9.png"][/img]
[i]She’s not wearing her usual dress - each character can have different outfits, and this is one of hers.[/i]

Aurora is a scientist. She loves understanding the bizarre occurrences throughout the world around her using rock-hard facts. She can help you study new manuals or find books at her bookshop. She also reads a lot of teenage romance novels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/9e04d59b0e2f30830b2b468122706bf1ee685126.png"][/img][i]Some of the cutest concepts Pedro has drawn for her.[/i]

She has breakfast outside her house in the mornings, and you can join her by sitting next to her.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/81f24fcf7ef856acade7b16bbe7125f7d912c2bb.gif"][/img][/p][p]One of our foundations in Neverway is to always tie our systems together, so we try to make most of the interactions meaningful in some way. For example, by sitting next to Aurora, you can get closer to her and receive a special buff after eating the berries.

Everyone will have their unique routines throughout the week: they can work at their job, eat breakfast or oversleep in the morning. They can also do things together like game nights or have picnics. Just to give an idea, we already have 150 different ones implemented in the game at this point. It turns out it’s a lot of work but we’re doing our best!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/30f8ef8af8a65c3da2bcab3e5f0dd1dc37d77f2b.png"][/img]
[i]We do all sorts of debug tools to help us with these systems. They help so much... I love debugging...[/i]

As a final note, we’re getting ready for our first in-person event, [b]BitSummit[/b] in Kyoto!!!!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/d2fa0e4f7452d32096f904fe65159688222921f1.png"][/img]
This will be our first time showing Neverway in public!!! We’re very nervous about this. But also excited!

We can’t wait to see how people react and play the game! We’ll also use all the feedback to make sure the game is in its best shape possible before showing it to you all. Although we don’t know yet when this is going to be!

I can probably spoil that, since Neverway is a narrative driven game, we’re taking the approach of a prologue, rather than a traditional “demo”. However, we [i]might[/i] have prepared a special mode that unlocks after you finish playing the prologue…

That’s all for now! We have even more cool things to announce… [i]soon[/i]… But, for now, you can just keep an eye here for any upcoming updates. Or, even better, join our newsletter: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/91b35219e6507b73b61326d2e63f1bebf2d0e088.png"][/img][url="https://neverwaygame.com/"] neverwaygame.com[/url]

You can let us know in the comments if there’s anything you want to see covered in the next updates, and thank you for reading!
🩸 Coldblood Inc.[/p]

notes.title: Summer Game Fest is here!
notes.notes: [p]It’s Summer Game Fest time, and it turns out we got to do a lot of cool things! We shared more about our gameplay with lots of new footage at [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oEm6wAdqfEY&t=3718"]Day of the Devs[/url], and announced that we’re localizing the game to Spanish (!!!) at [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=70GWayXSni8"]Latin American Games Showcase[/url].[/p][p]We have even more things to announce in these next few months that we can’t spoil yet, but we’re [b][i]VERY[/i][/b][i] [/i]excited!!! For now, just keep an eye on any upcoming updates here…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/22afac20782246a7c4042885e4185b3f762bc594.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Fiona is trying her best to survive the Summer.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Now let's jump into some content...[/b][/p][p]We previously explained how food works in the game and how you can use it to advance time. So... what else can you do to advance time?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/0b7c0a6f59dd76b4b9ceb85ec35c71719e2f1888.png"][/img][/p][p]As you may already know, time in Neverway is divided into three slots: morning, afternoon and evening. [/p][p]Time does pass [i]a little bit[/i] within a slot, but it only actually advances once you explicitly trigger an activity. This activity can be anything like eating, taking a shower, sleeping, reading a book, or dying. You probably should try not to die, though.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/fc548d64f03ffb201391b0a74a0539d45a4b0243.gif"][/img][/p][p]Whatever you choose to do impacts things like adding or removing buffs, recovering health, or new recipes that you learn.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Localization updates![/b][/p][p]We promised that you’d hear more from us on localization, and here we are: we’re localizing Neverway to [i]Brazilian Portuguese[/i], [i]Japanese[/i], [i]Simplified Chinese[/i], [i]Russian[/i], and [i]Spanish[/i]! [/p][p]Since we have a limited budget and our game has [i]a lot[/i] of words, we can’t commit to more than 5 languages for now. If Neverway does well after launch (fingers crossed!!), we promise do our best to support more languages — it’s definitely one of our priorities. We appreciate all your support and feedback![/p][p][/p][p]That’s all![/p][p]🩸 Coldblood Inc.[/p]

notes.title: Eerie Stardew Valley style RPG Neverway is the coolest take on the genre yet
notes.notes:
The life sim has, perhaps, become one of the most saturated genres out there. Everyone wants a slice of Stardew Valley's success, with games like Disney Dreamlight Valley injecting some Magic Kingdom sparkle, while Witchbrook puts a fantastical, playful horror spin on the genre. Yet, despite my attempts to stick with them in the same way I did Animal Crossing, I've never really found myself becoming #obsessed with any of Stardew's spiritual successors. Then Neverway appeared, and it's exactly what I've been waiting for.

Read the rest of the story...

Slay the Spire 2 is delayed, but it's twice as big and even more replayable

notes.title: Over 140,000 of you!
notes.notes:
We got over 100k wishlists in just five (5!!) days after the announcement. We are SO happy and grateful for everyone’s support, it's still a little hard to believe this! From everyone on the team: [b]thank you[/b] T_T

Also, just knowing that a lot of people are enjoying our weird ideas is incredibly motivating. We promise to do our best to make the best game we possibly can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/92285ecd7e951c80db1cb7068745663f4066e2b4.jpg[/img]
[i]The numbers keep going up…[/i]

For this month’s update, we thought we’d show you a little bit of the food in [i]Neverway[/i] (mmmhmmm). Basically, there are two ways you can eat in the game:
[olist]
[*] Eat it as a snack by “equipping” it
[*] Cook it into a meal and have it for dinner or lunch, which advances time
[/olist]
So let’s look at some examples. Here, take a corn on the cob. You can eat that anytime you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/8f19648aef409560067f64b0f5f9aa2a8a6e4558.png[/img]

Here's how you do it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/40649addae2e71a76e3d96d66e46682b5523242b.gif[/img]
Now, let’s say you want a proper meal, so you get yourself a delivery of instant noodles. You can sit down and have it for lunch, like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/4db65474b13fc9f91b404bf7c4827d4db74773ed.gif[/img]
We’ll cover in the next updates how exactly you can prepare and cook your food...

On another note, we want to confirm that we are looking into localizing the game to more languages! While we want to support as many as we can, we do have a limited budget, and this game has a [i]lot[/i] of words. That said, we still have some room left, so you [i]might[/i] hear more from us next month…

And that’s all, until next time!
🩸 Coldblood Inc.

notes.title: Neverway is a horror RPG that blends action and life sim elements that looks incredible
notes.notes:
With funding from Outersloth, the publishing arm of the Among Us developer Innersloth, Neverway is a new reveal from Coldblood Inc. A horror RPG that blends action and life sim elements and there's plenty of names involved in this one that you might recognise.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/neverway-is-a-horror-rpg-that-blends-action-and-life-sim-elements-that-looks-incredible/

notes.title: Into the Neverway
notes.notes:
We’re incredibly proud to announce [b]Neverway[/b], a horror RPG that blends action and life sim elements. Have you seen our trailer yet? If not, you should check it out right here!

[previewyoutube=c-ZYBv3qzN8;full][/previewyoutube]
You play the game as Fiona. 

After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt while searching for Neverway — a nightmare reality that’s slowly leaking into yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/095b63f1d3a08bbcd713153880ac29a8191b39c1.png[/img]

So, what do you do in the game, exactly? Well, here’s *some* of the things:
[list]
[*] Explore a post-apocalyptic world
[*] Make friends
[*] Fight in a fast-paced combat
[*] Decorate your home
[*] Pay your mortgage
[*] Die
[*] Get drunk
[*] Lie to your friends
[*] Use a LunaOS computer
[*] Farm, fish and cook
[*] Get into a situationship
[*] Upgrade combat abilities by bonding with friends
[*] Choose when to advance the time between: morning, afternoon and evening
[*] Craft and equip items
[/list] 
Yup. We definitely didn’t overscope there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577639/40732b98e764ad59753ef6333402ebbff95a1cc1.gif[/img]

Finally, we worked on a very cool website! There’s some extra content such as more screenshots, our amazing team members and Ç̸̛̥̲̫̥͔̻̰̭̣̤͚̖̫̦͔̣̲̮͎̬̮̠͉̞̼͕̪̅̎͐͐́́͌̈́̌̅̎͐́̀̔̂̔̌̽͛̋̾̈́͂̈́̇͆̈́͗͑͋́͗͘͜͝͠͝ͅ.̸̧̢̧̧̛͓͇̬͈̙͔̻̠̮͉̙̤͉̫̹̙̩̮̙͚̱͓̣̜̼̬̩̩͕̟̘̗͙̞̮͇̗͔͉̲̝̼̮̣͋͑̒̍̂̏̏̈́̇̒͐́͑̈̈́͊̽̎̆̆̇̐̎́͆̽̒̈́̀̈͒́̒̚͘̚͝͠͝R̶̡̨̧̢͈̼̼̫̬̼̝̹͕̰̯̺͎͓̻̜̝̗͈̰͇͚̰̘͙̹̬̱̮͚̘̩̳̞͆̊̿͌́̀̄̍̓̐̂͒͗̉͂̋̑̈̐̃̍͐͐̌͆͒̑̓͋͆͂̔̀̚̕͜͜͜͝ͅͅͅ.̴̡̧̢̧̛̼̼͎̼͕͇̯̦̞̻̜̥͈̰̠̘̹͍̰̳̖̪͇͕̪̺͙̜͔̜͇̳̲̹̬͕̯̝̹̗͖͇̻̜̯̓̀̈́̊̔̄̊͋̔̔͋̈̈́̌͊͘̚͘͝͝O̷̡̧̨̢̡̡̧̧̧̺͓̬͇̩̼̜̹͈̻͇̤͔͕͔̗̰͇̤͚͕̫͚̥̳̝̳͉̟̫̤͓̙͈̻̘͉̟͎̗̤͒͑͆͊̄̂͗͋̈̄͐͊̑̆͒͛͊̆̀͋͌͊̋̓͗͂̒̀̉́̀́̊̆̿̈́̇͋̿͊̔͋̄̋̃̽̈́̕͘͘͜͜͜͜͠͝͝ͅ.̸̧̧̡̛̱̭̜̹̗̼̞͕̹̟̗̤̞̯̣̲̭͈̠̐̀̀͌̈́̊̈́̊̀̄͊͐̽̕̕͠ͅS̶̨̡̢̛̖̘̻̪̥͎̗̯̭̗̠̖͔̺͇͎̿͌̀͒̄̃͗͗̂̑̐̾́̎̅̀̈̃͋̍̊̌̄͗̔̂͘͜͝.̶̡̧̢̪̭̱͍͔͇̺̞̘͚̫̻͔͍̝̥̰͍́̉̌̉̔͜S̷̨͓̟̜͕͓̗̘͖̬͔͔̭͔͈͓̫̲̳͇̭̦͈̝̉̓̆̓͗̑̽̀͑͋̃̐̂̈́̒̈́̋̌̏̇̊̊̎́̀̓̐͐̚̕͜͜͠͠.̵̡͕̝̳̘̝̯̭͈͕̼̩̘̯͙͍̈͆̆̍
